data.Q: Who invites the man of God to eat at his home?
Whose word forbids the man of God to eat or drink there?
What happens before the man of God refuses to go with the prophet?
data.A: The prophet invites the man of God to eat.
data.wrong_answer: The man of God reports the Lord’s command.

data.Q: What travel rule does the Lord give the man of God?
data.A: The man of God must not go back by the same route.
data.wrong_answer: The man of God must not go with the prophet.

data.Q: What does the man of God say he cannot do with the prophet?
data.A: The man of God cannot go back with the prophet.
data.wrong_answer: The man of God cannot go back by the same route.
